## Summary

Describe the change and the boot, image, test, or userland boundary it affects.

## Validation

List the exact commands and semantic gates run. Attach only redacted, redistributable logs.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped and does not rewrite preserved history.
- [ ] `git diff --check` passes.
- [ ] Relevant runner, preview, boot-chain, or userland tests pass.
- [ ] Documentation and known limitations are updated.
- [ ] No secrets, personal paths, generated binaries, or proprietary material were added.
- [ ] Third-party copyright and license notices are preserved.
- [ ] New or modified CaribeOS files carry the appropriate project license notice.
